author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Troubled production history. Controversial casting. Studio conflicts. Disastrous test screenings. Emergency reshoots. Skyrocketing budgets, and deeply divisive trailers. 
If the rumours are to believed, then Greta Gerwig’s upcoming Narnia reboot has all the ingredients of an absolute stinker, but is that really the full story? Let's find out.

title: Narnia - What The Hell Is Going On With This Movie?
